retraction.reason: Re-read on 24 September under A14(6), against the rule that replaced M44b’s: a record earns its place by carrying at least one honest edge to anything already in the atlas, and nothing is written in order to keep one. The corpus is now 859 active events across all five lanes, and no longer the Portuguese core M44b judged this against. This convention stands with the one on diplomatic relations. It codifies practice, and the atlas holds no event it decided. The Charter edge is available, it is true of a dozen records, and it argues nothing. It is marked here rather than written, and now under the new rule rather than M44b’s.
